_note: Motes: the one currency outside a run. Bands are a printed tell for now, so a rarity system later changes this file and AdventureEconomy.band() and nothing else.
_payout_note: Motes per won duel by act (index 0 is act 1), and per act boss. A typical full run of 3 or 4 duels an act pays about 545 with the completion bonus.
_slots_note: Deck slots are bought per starter and kept for good. The Nth slot costs slot_cost_base * slot_cost_growth^(N-1), rounded to slot_cost_round. A starter may buy slots until its deck reaches DeckValidator's maximum, so a 53-card starter has 32 to buy and the whole track costs 20110, about 37 full wins at roughly 545 each.
_mana_note: Mana: the per-run currency (design 7.6). A run starts with `start`, each won fight pays `income` by node type plus `income_per_act` for every act after the first, and it is spent only at Shops. It is gone when the run ends and never turns into Motes. A Shop holds `shop_stock` single cards priced by the same printed-tell band as Motes prices.
_relic_note: The Relic node (design 7.5): three offers, each a distinct Relic from `pool` with a Reserve set from reserve_bundles.json. A Relic in `needs_ally` is offered only to a run whose Life Deck or Reserve holds a personality card. relic_03, the Lodestone Heart, is the final boss's and never offered.
